newsitem.title: USA: BPA leaves Monday power prices mostly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: BPA leaves Monday power prices mostly unchanged.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left most price offers for surplus power on Monday unchanged, the agency said Friday.
BPA still offered 300 megawatts of firm peak power at $12.25 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest sales and $13.25 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
BPA also continued to offer power at $7.00 per MWh during hours ending 0100-0600 and 2300-2400 PST to buyers willing to displace thermal generation with hydropower.
Non-firm power during shoulder hours on Monday (0700, 1100-1700 and 2100-2200 PST) was unchanged at $9.00 per MWh for Northwest deliveries, while COB prices were raised by $1.00 to $10.00.
Prices for firm and non-firm power during off-peak hours on Monday were unchanged at $9.00 per MWh.
